name: robkit
//: check: the fast gate. Formatting, knip, lint, types and the tests that need no Docker (each package's test:unit). Runs on Windows.
check:all: what CI runs. The same, with every test (each package's test), including the ones that start Postgres and the whole-stack test. Needs Docker and Linux.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm knip && turbo run lint typecheck test:unit
scripts.check:all: pnpm format:check && pnpm knip && turbo run lint typecheck test
